title: VENSUKO Launcher 0.15.2 - Profile Gallery Redesign
notes:
VENSUKO Launcher 0.15.2 - Profile Gallery Redesign

- Browse profile pictures and banners in separate tabs with compact, scrollable galleries.
- Find approved artwork using search, categories and sorting.
- Save favorites and preview selections on your profile before saving.
- Refresh the Supabase artwork catalog without restarting VENSUKO.
- See unsaved changes, save from the profile header or reset to the default appearance.
- Existing profiles, game libraries, privacy settings and DropDash integration remain intact.
